item.title: Offering Paid R Data Analysis Services – Ready to Help with Your Projects
item.description:
Hi everyone! I'm offering **data analysis services in R** on a **paid basis** – whether it's cleaning, visualization, statistical modeling, or report generation using packages like `tidyverse`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`, `caret`, etc.
I'm experienced in working with research datasets (including public health and social sciences), and can help with tasks like:
* Data wrangling & preprocessing * Hypothesis testing * Regression & classification models * Time series or survey data * Creating beautiful plots and dashboards * Writing reproducible code and reports (R Markdown)
